text:
These are bubbles for student notes. When they add notes, they are timestamped and organized in a continuous feed similar to Teams, Slack, or iMessage. Students can save their notes, then add additional notes later throughout the semester. 

Instructors can view their notes and they can create note-taking assignments. When the assignments are created, they are automatically pushed to the students note-taking feed in-line with their notes. The assignments can contain tables and mages, and provide response fields so students can complete the assignment in their note's feed and then submit them from there. The assignments remain on their feed. 

When instructors review their submissions, they can add notes, highlight sections, and create bubble feedback messages similar to Microsoft Word. All of these comments remain in the student's feed so they can scroll through their notes for later review. 

Students can download their notes as a PDF or a Word Document if they wish.
